# baffinbay_custom_page (Data Source)

Retrieves a Baffin Bay Custom Page by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "baffinbay_custom_page" "waf_block" {
  id = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the custom page to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) The HTML content downloaded from the custom page file endpoint.
- `created_at` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String)
